body_html:
#smallpoems
When
Answers double over
from within while
A summer wind
Rescinds sin Nestled
on a tongue curled
Life ferns at the feet.
The breeze calls the pain
On surging upturned leaves
Who howl for forgotten son
Collisions of sun collectors
Chloropast pushing
Against unwanted disaster
As birds chirp on. Singing,
This too shall pass
